headline: David Raya to be assessed after leaving Arsenal's draw at Newcastle with injury
description: David Raya was forced off the pitch in Arsenal's clash against Newcastle.

headline: Noni Madueke rescues a point for Arsenal against Newcastle in thrilling 2-2 draw
description: Noni Madueke snatched a 2-2 draw for Arsenal after Newcastle produced a stunning second-half turnaround to claim a deserved point against the Premier League leaders.

headline: Premier League recap: Newcastle draw Arsenal, Leeds upset Chelsea
description: Club soccer returned across Europe this weekend following the final international break of 2026. Check out all the highlights from Saturday's action.

headline: Alonso: Chelsea stopped believing after Leeds' equaliser
description: Xabi Alonso explains where it went wrong for Chelsea after a 4-1 defeat against Leeds in the Premier League.

headline: Tottenham's De Zerbi likens Williams-Barnett to Yamal after star stunning full debut
description: Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi was not surprised by a dazzling full debut display from "special" talent Luca Williams-Barnett and compared the 18-year-old to Barcelona's Lamine Yamal.

headline: Enzo Maresca: Man City denied 'clear' goal in draw with Fulham
description: Enzo Maresca said Manchester City were denied a "clear" goal in their 1-1 draw with Fulham after Erling Haaland was judged to have fouled goalkeeper Bernd Leno.
